functions.name: finance_document_assert_request
finance_document_candidate
functions.source:
<<document_preview>>
DECLARE review_row record; r jsonb; selected jsonb; s jsonb; x jsonb; identity jsonb; observation jsonb; result jsonb;
 issues jsonb:='[]'; aliases jsonb:='[]'; sources jsonb:='[]'; snapshots jsonb:='[]'; company jsonb;
 full_descriptor jsonb; base_descriptor jsonb; safe_snapshot jsonb; current_counterparty text; unusable boolean:=false;
 key_hash text; base_hash text; descriptor_hash text; ns text; doc text; portion text; date_value text; official text; token text;
 basis text; other_basis text; active_apps integer:=0; candidate_count integer:=0; ver integer:=0; gross numeric; net numeric; tax numeric;
 actual_doc text; saved finance_document_registry%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_kind NOT IN('card','hometax','tax_invoice') OR p_kind IS NULL OR finance_supply_id(to_jsonb(p_source)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR finance_supply_id(to_jsonb(p_subject)) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR finance_supply_id(to_jsonb(p_review_revision)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid document selection' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT v.*,c.subject_id AS case_subject INTO review_row FROM finance_supply_review_revisions v
 JOIN finance_supply_review_cases c USING(case_id) WHERE revision_id=p_review_revision;
 IF NOT FOUND OR review_row.case_subject<>p_subject OR review_row.state<>'recorded'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_supply_review_revisions WHERE case_id=review_row.case_id AND version>review_row.version)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(review_row.payload_json->'members') m WHERE m->>'kind'=p_kind AND m->>'sourceId'=p_source)
 THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('review_selection_unavailable','최신 기록판에 포함된 원천을 선택하세요.');
 END IF;
 IF p_kind='card' THEN
  SELECT to_jsonb(t) INTO selected FROM card_transactions t WHERE card_txn_id=p_source;
  IF selected IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT finance_document_card_token(card_num) INTO token FROM card_registry WHERE card_id=selected->>'card_id';
   date_value:=left(selected->>'approved_at',10);
   IF token IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_identity_unavailable','카드 식별 근거를 확인하세요.'); END IF;
   IF selected->>'approval_type' IS DISTINCT FROM '승인' THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_type_unsupported','첫 등록은 유형이 확인된 승인 건만 지원합니다.'); END IF;
   IF COALESCE(selected->>'approval_num','')='' OR selected->>'approval_num' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    OR selected->>'approved_at' !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$'
   THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_approval_unavailable','승인번호와 초 단위 승인일시가 필요합니다.'); END IF;
   net:=(selected->>'supply_amount')::numeric;tax:=(selected->>'tax_amount')::numeric;gross:=(selected->>'amount_total')::numeric;
   IF COALESCE((selected->>'service_charge')::numeric,0)<>0 THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_service_unsupported','봉사료가 있는 승인은 별도 검토가 필요합니다.'); END IF;
   IF selected#>>'{raw_json,CurrencyCode}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'KRW' THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_currency_unverified','원문 통화가 KRW로 확인된 승인만 등록할 수 있습니다.');END IF;
   ns:='mcm-card-approval-v1';base_descriptor:=jsonb_build_array('de1a-card-base-v1',token,selected->>'approval_num',selected->>'approved_at','purchase');base_hash:=finance_document_hash(base_descriptor);
   key_hash:=finance_document_hash(jsonb_build_array('de1a-card-full-v1',base_hash,abs(gross)));
   full_descriptor:=jsonb_build_array(ns,base_descriptor,gross);descriptor_hash:=finance_document_hash(full_descriptor);
   SELECT count(*) INTO candidate_count FROM card_transactions t JOIN card_registry c USING(card_id)
    WHERE finance_document_card_token(c.card_num)=token AND COALESCE(t.approval_num,'')=COALESCE(selected->>'approval_num','')
      AND t.approved_at=selected->>'approved_at' AND t.approval_type='승인';
   IF candidate_count<>1 THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_base_identity_conflict','같은 승인 기본키의 복수 원천을 확인하세요.'); END IF;
   aliases:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind','card','row',selected));
  END IF;
 ELSE
  IF p_kind='hometax' THEN SELECT to_jsonb(t) INTO selected FROM hometax_tax_invoices t WHERE hti_id=p_source;
  ELSE SELECT to_jsonb(t) INTO selected FROM tax_invoices t WHERE invoice_id=p_source;END IF;
  IF selected IS NOT NULL THEN
   official:=btrim(selected->>'nts_send_key');date_value:=selected->>'write_date';
   IF official IS NULL OR official='' OR official !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$' THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('official_key_unavailable','공식 승인번호를 확인하세요.'); END IF;
   net:=(selected->>'amount_total')::numeric;tax:=(selected->>'tax_total')::numeric;gross:=(selected->>'total_amount')::numeric;
   ns:='kr-nts-approval';key_hash:=finance_document_hash(jsonb_build_array(ns,official));
   full_descriptor:=jsonb_build_array(ns,official);descriptor_hash:=finance_document_hash(full_descriptor);
   SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(a ORDER BY a->>'kind',a->'row'->>'hti_id',a->'row'->>'invoice_id'),'[]') INTO aliases FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','hometax','row',to_jsonb(t)) a FROM hometax_tax_invoices t WHERE btrim(t.nts_send_key)=official
    UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','tax_invoice','row',to_jsonb(t)) FROM tax_invoices t WHERE btrim(t.nts_send_key)=official
   ) all_aliases;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF selected IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_missing','선택한 원천을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
 ELSE
  IF net IS NULL OR tax IS NULL OR gross IS NULL OR net<0 OR tax<0 OR gross<=0 OR net+tax<>gross
   OR greatest(abs(net),abs(tax),abs(gross))>9007199254740991 OR net<>trunc(net) OR tax<>trunc(tax) OR gross<>trunc(gross)
  THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('amount_unsupported','원 단위 양수 전체 금액을 확인하세요.');unusable:=true; END IF;
  company:=finance_document_subject(p_subject,date_value);
  IF company IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('subject_unresolved','업무일의 단일 회사 기준을 확인하세요.');unusable:=true; END IF;
  IF vat_followup_date(date_value) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR (p_kind='card' AND token IS NULL) THEN unusable:=true;END IF;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(aliases) LOOP
   r:=x->'row';
   IF x->>'kind'='card' THEN
    s:=jsonb_build_object('kind','card','id',r->>'card_txn_id','date',date_value,'direction','purchase','cardToken',token,
     'approvalType',r->'approval_type','approvalNumber',r->'approval_num','approvedAt',r->'approved_at','supply',r->'supply_amount','tax',r->'tax_amount','total',r->'amount_total',
     'serviceCharge',r->'service_charge','storeCorpNum',r->'store_corp_num','storeTaxType',r->'store_tax_type','excluded',r->'excluded',
     'observationState',r->'is_purchased','currency',r#>'{raw_json,CurrencyCode}',
     'historyKeyHash',finance_document_hash(r->'history_key'),'dedupKeyHash',finance_document_hash(r->'dedup_key'),'rawHash',finance_document_hash(r->'raw_json'));
   ELSE
    s:=jsonb_build_object('kind',x->>'kind','id',COALESCE(r->>'hti_id',r->>'invoice_id'),'date',r->'write_date','direction',r->'direction',
     'approvalNumber',btrim(r->>'nts_send_key'),'supply',r->'amount_total','tax',r->'tax_total','total',r->'total_amount','taxType',r->'tax_type',
     'modifyCode',r->'modify_code','supplier',r->'invoicer_corp_num','supplierName',r->'invoicer_corp_name','recipient',r->'invoicee_corp_num','recipientName',r->'invoicee_corp_name','excluded',r->'excluded','cancelledAt',r->'canceled_at',
     'sendState',r->'nts_send_state','originalInvoiceId',r->'original_invoice_id','rawWriteDate',r#>'{raw_json,WriteDate}',
     'originalApprovalNumber',r#>'{raw_json,OriginalNTSConfirmNum}','originalNtsSendKey',r#>'{raw_json,OriginalNTSSendKey}',
     'lineItemsHash',finance_document_hash(r->'line_items'),'rawHash',finance_document_hash(r->'raw_json'));
    current_counterparty:=CASE r->>'direction' WHEN 'purchase' THEN r->>'invoicer_corp_num' WHEN 'sales' THEN r->>'invoicee_corp_num' END;
    IF current_counterparty IS NULL OR current_counterparty !~ '^[0-9]{10}$' THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('invoice_counterparty_unverified','문서 방향과 거래처 번호를 확인하세요.');END IF;
    other_basis:=finance_document_hash(jsonb_build_array(r->'write_date',r->'direction',r->'amount_total',r->'tax_total',r->'total_amount',r->'tax_type',COALESCE(r->>'modify_code',''),current_counterparty));
    IF basis IS NOT NULL AND basis<>other_basis THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('official_invoice_content_conflict','같은 승인번호의 문서 내용이 서로 다릅니다.'); END IF;basis:=other_basis;
    IF x->>'kind'='tax_invoice' AND r->>'canceled_at' IS NULL AND COALESCE((r->>'nts_send_state')::integer,0)=4 THEN active_apps:=active_apps+1;END IF;
    IF x->>'kind'='hometax' AND (COALESCE(r#>>'{raw_json,WriteDate}','') !~ '^[0-9]{8}$' OR r#>>'{raw_json,WriteDate}' IS DISTINCT FROM replace(r->>'write_date','-','')) THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_date_unverified','원문 작성일과 저장 작성일이 일치하지 않습니다.');END IF;
    IF company IS NOT NULL AND x->>'kind'='hometax' AND (CASE r->>'direction' WHEN 'purchase' THEN r->>'invoicee_corp_num' WHEN 'sales' THEN r->>'invoicer_corp_num' ELSE '' END) IS DISTINCT FROM company->>'corpNum'
     THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_subject_conflict','문서 주체와 선택한 회사가 다릅니다.');END IF;
   END IF;
   IF COALESCE((r->>'excluded')::integer,0)<>0 OR r->>'canceled_at' IS NOT NULL THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_inactive','제외 또는 취소된 문서는 첫 등록에서 보류됩니다.');END IF;
   IF x->>'kind'='tax_invoice' AND COALESCE((r->>'nts_send_state')::integer,0)<>4 THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_not_transmitted','공식 전송 완료 상태를 확인하세요.');END IF;
   IF COALESCE(r->>'modify_code','')<>'' THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('correction_unsupported','수정 문서는 별도 계보 검토가 필요합니다.');END IF;
   snapshots:=snapshots||jsonb_build_array(s);
   sources:=sources||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind',s->>'kind','id',s->>'id','sourceHash',finance_document_hash(s)));
  END LOOP;
  IF active_apps>1 THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('multiple_active_app_invoice_rows','같은 승인번호의 활성 앱 문서가 여러 개입니다.');END IF;
  doc:='fdoc-'||key_hash;portion:='fdp-'||key_hash;
  SELECT d.* INTO saved FROM finance_document_registry d WHERE d.document_id=doc OR (d.namespace=ns AND d.key_hash=document_preview.key_hash) LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND AND (saved.subject_id<>p_subject OR saved.descriptor_hash<>descriptor_hash OR saved.base_key_hash IS DISTINCT FROM base_hash
   OR saved.descriptor_json IS DISTINCT FROM full_descriptor OR saved.base_descriptor_json IS DISTINCT FROM base_descriptor)
   THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('registered_identity_conflict','이미 등록한 문서의 식별 근거와 다릅니다.');END IF;
  IF base_hash IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_document_reservations q WHERE q.base_key_hash=base_hash AND q.document_id<>doc)
   THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('card_base_identity_conflict','기존 승인 기본키의 문서와 금액 또는 원천이 다릅니다.');END IF;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(sources) LOOP
   SELECT document_id INTO actual_doc FROM finance_document_sources WHERE source_kind=x->>'kind' AND source_id=x->>'id';
   IF actual_doc IS NOT NULL AND actual_doc<>doc THEN issues:=issues||finance_document_issue('source_identity_changed','원천이 기존 문서와 다른 식별자로 바뀌었습니다.');END IF;
  END LOOP;
  SELECT COALESCE(max(version),0) INTO ver FROM finance_document_observations WHERE document_id=doc;
  identity:=jsonb_build_object('namespace',ns,'keyHash',key_hash,'baseKeyHash',base_hash,'descriptorHash',descriptor_hash);
  safe_snapshot:=jsonb_build_object('sourceSnapshots',snapshots,'subject',company,'reviewHash',review_row.preview_hash,'descriptor',full_descriptor,'baseDescriptor',base_descriptor);
  observation:=jsonb_build_object('subjectRevisionId',company->>'revisionId','date',date_value,'direction',CASE WHEN p_kind='card' THEN 'purchase' ELSE selected->>'direction' END,
   'approvalNumber',CASE WHEN p_kind='card' THEN selected->>'approval_num' ELSE official END,'supply',net,'tax',tax,'total',gross,'sources',sources,
   'snapshotHash',finance_document_hash(safe_snapshot));
 END IF;
 IF unusable THEN identity:=NULL;observation:=NULL;doc:=NULL;portion:=NULL;ver:=0;END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','de1a-document-preview-v1','subjectId',p_subject,'reviewRevisionId',p_review_revision,
  'source',jsonb_build_object('kind',p_kind,'id',p_source),'canRegister',jsonb_array_length(issues)=0,'issues',issues,'documentId',doc,'portionId',portion,'version',ver,
  'identity',identity,'observation',observation);
 RETURN result||jsonb_build_object('previewHash',finance_document_hash(result),'_safeSnapshot',safe_snapshot,'_descriptor',full_descriptor,'_baseDescriptor',base_descriptor);
END
